scope: First economic discovery screen only; no runtime change or paper nomination. All history reused. No 2026 outcomes opened.
hypothesis: Persistent directional evidence after volatility normalization can identify larger moves and avoid costly one-day shock entries. Bounded evidence S01 is the single primary; unbounded S00 is the mechanistic control. Not a probability forecast or an assumption that financial returns are Gaussian.
prior_overlap_audit: T01 prior20day channel breakout and R01/R03 cross-sectional28day rotation already tested. Earlier hourly compression/retest, pullback, relative-value/continuation, funding exhaustion, range reversion, shock/network and Cipher tests recorded. This is sequential change evidence, not a new token whitelist or another channel length. Momentum mechanism overlaps; no statistical independence claim.

data.universe: 96 retained perpetual tokens, actual available history; historical dead tokens retained within this supplied universe, not a point-in-time whole-exchange universe
data.time_split: 2022 development reporting; 2023-25 later evaluation already repeatedly researched, not clean holdout

signal.clock: Daily midnight UTC after all24hourly closes complete; bar close timestamps belong to preceding day. No external volume/depth assumed.
signal.scale: Population std of60 complete DAILY log returns immediately preceding the current daily return. Exclude current observation. No filling missing daily returns. Require all60.
signal.z: current daily log return / prior sigma; zero drift null reference.
signal.S01: clip z to [-3,+3]; Cplus=max(0,Cplus+z-0.5), Cminus=max(0,Cminus-z-0.5). Long when Cplus>=5; short when Cminus>=5. Reset both after any signal, including signals while occupied. Missing z resets evidence.
signal.S00: Identical but z is unbounded. Only one primary and one control; no parameter grid.
signal.parameter_rationale: NIST conventional k=0.5,h=5 are an external initial design, not finance significance calibration. The analyst-selected3sigma cap limits one daily observation to2.5 evidence units; at least two daily observations needed. No parameters fit to historical PnL.

trade.entry: New threshold event, next minute open (main +1min; delay +6min), one open position per token/arm/cost/timing. Signals at or before prior exit are unavailable; no immediate flip. No refilling missed signals.
trade.stop: Fixed raw_entry*(1-side*2*entry_sigma). Executable stop distance must be0.5%-15%; reject nonpositive stop. No target, trailing adjustment or max holding time.
trade.exit: Opposite subsequent threshold at its decision+delay, or first observed minute-open stop breach filled next minute. Stop wins same-clock conflict. Invalid scale exits on daily clock. End-of-history marks explicit.
trade.funding: Actual recorded settlements strictly after entry through exit, signed quantity*settlement minute-open price proxy; no mark-price history. Funding age <=480min and settlement quote finite required. First missing quote/stale funding terminates at last valid mark, costs charged, data_censor flag; later entries for that token/book stopped. Censor is not an executable fill.
trade.notional: 1000USDT executed entry per independent opportunity, quantity fixed. Overlapping token opportunities are NOT a shared funded account; totals/R/drawdowns do not imply account ROI.

costs.roles: Baseline/moderate and exact0.31%perleg desk lead; severe secondary, not sole veto. Each cost independently admits by stop distance; fixed baseline-sample repricing also reported.

risk_metric: R=net trade PnL / original executable-entry-to-raw-stop price risk, includes costs/funding in numerator. Planned cost-aware loss shown separately. Sum R unweighted; opportunity drawdown USDT/R measured at observed minute opens, not funded-equity drawdown%.

screen_gate.positive: Full2022-25 and later2023-25 entry-cohort AND calendar net >0 at baseline/moderate/desk; later closed-only net >0.
screen_gate.annual: At least2of3 later calendar years positive under each central cost.
screen_gate.latency: Later and full cohort/calendar remain positive for+6min at all3central costs.
screen_gate.support: At least100 closed later entries,26entryweeks,10tokens in each central main case; unexpected data-censors<=1% of later entries.
screen_gate.funding: Later net minus1% of sum absolute funding cashflows positive under each central cost (proxy sensitivity).
screen_gate.control: Compare S01 minusS00; control cannot silently replace primary. Concentration, confidence intervals mandatory diagnostics, not post-hoc parameter changes.
screen_gate.if_pass: Proceed to matched funded account study vs I and IC on same costs/risk/data and exact control reconciliation; no claim of superiority before this.
screen_gate.if_fail: Reject frozen specification; record loss/win characteristics and distinct next question; no historical winner-token list.

statistics.bootstrap: 4000 synchronized calendar week circular block draws,4week primary and13week sensitivity. Seed20261026+block. Main full/later meanR and netPnl; 6primary central cost×period economic contrasts. Bonferroni family95% quantiles0.025/6 and1-0.025/6; also ordinary95%. Current-family correction only, earlier adaptive search uncorrected.
statistics.attribution: Annual/full/later, all96tokens inclzero, sector, side, priorBTC7day up>=5/down<=-5/sideways; win probability and win/loss severity, duration, top5concentration. Descriptive cells cannot create filters.

benchmark_context.rule: Display inherited funded account performance in separately labelled panel. No direct comparison with unlimited-opportunity R or ROI. New matched comparison only after screen passes.
